            format(axis, len(data_shape))

        batch_dims = node.batch_dims
        assert -len(indices_shape) <= batch_dims <= len(indices_shape), \
            'batch_dims must be within interval [-indices_rank, indices_rank]. Instead got batch_dims = {}, ' \
